question_en:
I am proofreading the SIMBAD object records for the Big Dipper in the image. Please start from the star at the top right of the bowl marked with α, and read the primary object type code and spectral type for each object. If the primary object type code is exactly `**`, stop immediately; codes that are similar but not identical do not meet the condition. When moving, first go down along the green line into the bowl, then proceed clockwise along the bowl, turning into the handle at the connection point. Do not visit stars repeatedly. Each time, visit only the next black star along the green line that is marked with both a Bayer letter and a name. Please answer the following questions:
1. Which objects were visited in order? List them as "Bayer mark—Name in image—Primary object type code—Spectral type".
2. Which of the visited objects have the same primary object type code?
3. How many different object records were checked in total, and at which object did you stop?

Answer format: Please answer in points numbered (1)–(3). For question 1, use a table to list the four object fields in order. For question 2, list the objects with the same type and their code in text. For question 3, give the total number of records and the endpoint in text.
answer:
(1)

| Visit Order | Bayer Mark | Name in Image | Primary Object Type Code | Spectral Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | α UMa | Dubhe | SB* | G9III+A7.5 |
| 2 | β UMa | Merak | PM* | A1IVps |
| 3 | γ UMa | Phecda | Em* | A0V |
| 4 | δ UMa | Megrez | PM* | A2Vn |
| 5 | ε UMa | Alioth | a2* | A1III-IVpkB9 |
| 6 | ζ UMa | Mizar | ** | ~ (Not provided) |

(2) β UMa (Merak) and δ UMa (Megrez) have the same primary object type code, which is PM*.

(3) A total of 6 different object records were checked, stopping finally at ζ UMa (Mizar).
